title: Indian English Literature - A Critical Survey (1980-2000)

vibeProfile.oneLine: A critical survey of Indian English literature, 1980 to 2000.

summary: Shyamala A. Narayan's critical survey covers Indian English literature from 1980 to 2000, the decades when it surged onto the world stage. It reviews the fiction, poetry, drama and non-fiction of the period, discussing the boom that followed Midnight's Children and the many new voices who reshaped Indian writing in English. A useful reference and critical guide to a rich and transformative twenty years, aimed at students and scholars of contemporary Indian literature.
whyReadIt: A critical survey of Indian English literature's world-conquering years, 1980 to 2000. Useful reference and guide.
